research_topic_or_condition.description: The topic, trend, claim, or condition to transform into a what-if premise.

domain_context.description: Optional field, institution, technology, social context, or design domain.

stakeholders.description: People, publics, organizations, or nonhuman actors affected by the premise.

assumptions.description: Assumptions that may be intensified, reversed, or questioned.

time_horizon.description: Near, mid, far, or custom future horizon.

image_semantics.description: Optional description when the input includes an image node.
